newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Handelsbanken offers warrants in building.
newsitem.headline: Handelsbanken offers warrants in building.

text.p: Svenska Handelsbanken said it will offer the public one million warrants in a basket of building companies including Skanska and NCC.
The warrants will run from December 2, 1996 until November 27, 1998 and the price will be 100 percent of the basket's value based on closing prices on November 29, 1996.
It said the warrants will be quoted on the Stockholm bourse on December 2 and Handelsbanken will make a secondary market throughout the warrants' duration.
Handelsbanken said registration was November 21-28, 1996 and it reserved the right to increase or decrease this during the registration period.
